2.desc: Gain Expertise in an Intelligence-based skill such as Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion.

3.name: Wizard Subclass
3.desc: Choose an Arcane Tradition subclass, gaining its features now and at later levels.

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
4.desc: Increase one ability score by 2 or two by 1 (max 20), or take a feat.

5.name: Memorize Spell
5.desc: After a short rest you can swap one prepared wizard spell for another from your spellbook.
